svg.title: Prepare the deoxygenated Cd/GSH charge
svg.desc: Conceptual stage diagram. Argon deoxygenation and dissolution context; exact order and gas-delivery geometry unresolved.
svg.text: The source combines 0.0285 g CdCl2·2.5H2O and 0.0384 g GSH
with 100 mL water and reports 30 min deoxygenation under
argon in advance. Whether water alone or the mixture is
deoxygenated is ambiguous. Complete dissolution uses magnetic
